1  ... Accused  (By Sri.G.L, Advocate)

Offences complained of : Secs.498A, 504, 506 R/w Sec.34 of  IPC and Secs.3 & 4 of D.P.Act Opinion of the Judge : Accused No.1 and 2 found not  guilty.

(GIRISH CHATNI)
 XXIX ACJM, BENGALURU  3  C.C.No.61212/2024  JUDGMENT The P.I., of K.R.Puram Police Station, Bengaluru, has filed the present charge sheet against the accused No.1 and 2 for the offence punishable under sections Secs.498A, 504, 506 R/w Sec.34 of IPC and Secs.3 & 4 of D.P.Act.
2.
BRIEF FACTS OF THE PROSECUTION CASE ARE AS UNDER :

It is the case of the complainant that, CW.1 got married to accused No.1 on 20.10.2021 at 'Achyutha Subramani Kalyana Mantapa', Nelluru, Andra Pradesh and at the time of marriage as per the demand of accused No.2, CW.2 and 3 have given 50 grams Gold ornaments and Cash of Rs.5,00,000/- to the accused No.1 and performed the marriage with the expense of Rs.27,00,000/-.

After the marriage CW-1 has led marital life at her matrimonial house situated at Flat No.302, Alfa Garden Sai Paradise, Kodigehalli Main Road, K.R.Puram along with accused No.1 and 2,
thereafter, accused No.1 and 2 with a common intention have physically and mentally subjected CW.1 to cruelty to bring 50 Lakhs dowry from her parental house to start a new company and to purchase a new site.

It is further alleged that, in the month of April-2022, C.C.No.61212/2024 accused No.1 and 2 picked up quarrel with CW.1 State By Kr Puram Ps vs Sai Teja Man Gunta on 5 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36189317/
2 without any reason and demanded 50 Lakhs dowry from her parental house, abused her in filthy language and throwed her from their house, by knowing the said fact,
CW.2 to 5 came to the house of accused No.1 and 2 and questioned about the same,
by that time, accused No.1 and 2 again demanded 50 Lakhs dowry from them, abused them in filthy language and threatened them by saying that they will kill the CW.1 with dire consequences.

sentences.text: Based on the typed complaint lodged by C.W.1, CW.8 has registered the case against accused No.1 and 2 in P.S. Crime No.187/2024 for the offence punishable under sections 498(a), 504, 506 R/w 34 of IPC and sections 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

Investigating Officers/ CW.8 to 10 investigated the matter,
after completion of the investigation, CW.10 has submitted final report against the accused No.1and 2 for the above said offences.
3. Upon receipt of charge sheet, cognizance was taken for the above mentioned offences alleged against the accused No.1 and 2 and registered the criminal case against them.

4. After registration of the case, the accused No.1 and 2 have appeared before this court and enlarged on bail as C.C.No.61212/2024 they were obtained anticipatory bail from the Hon'ble Sessions Court.
Copies of the final report and its' enclosures were furnished to them in compliance of section 207 of Cr.P.C.
Sufficient grounds were made out to frame charges.
Hence, charges framed and read over to the accused No.1 and 2.
They pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.

5. In order to prove the guilt of the accused No.1 and 2, the prosecution has examined one witness out of 10 witnesses cited in the charge sheet as P.W.1 and relied upon documents as per Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.10 and closed its side.
In lieu of absence of incriminating circumstances appearing against accused No.1 and 2, recording of their statement under section 313 of Cr.P.C. was dispensed with.
6. Heard both sides.
Perused the materials on record.

7. The points that arise for my consideration are;
1. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that the accused No.1 was married with CW.1 on 20.10.2021 and thereafter, the accused No.1 and 2 with a common intention have subjected CW.1 to cruelty by harassing her both by physically C.C.No.61212/2024 and mentally and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.498A R/w Sec.34 of IPC ?

2. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, the accused No.1 and 2 in furtherance of common intention have picked up quarrel with CW.1 for small issues and abused CW.1 in filthy language and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.504 R/w 34 of IPC ?

3. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, the accused No.1 and 2 in furtherance of common intention have threatened CW.1 with dire consequences and thereby State By Kr Puram Ps vs Sai Teja Man Gunta on 5 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36189317/
3 committed an offence punishable U/s.506 R/w 34 of IPC ?
4.

sentences.text: Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, the accused No.1 and 2 has demanded 50 Lakhs dowry from the parents of CW.1 and have subjected her to cruelty both by physically and mentally and C.C.No.61212/2024 thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act ?
5. What Order?

8. My findings on the above points are as under:
 Point Nos.1 to 4 : In the Negative.
 Point No.5 : As per the final order  for the following;
 REASONS  9. POINT Nos.1 to 4 :-
As these four points are interlinked, I have taken up these points together for common discussion to avoid repeti- tion of facts & evidence.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 and 2, the prosecution has examined the complainant/victim/C.W.1 as P.W.1 and relied upon ten documents.

10. In order to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 and 2, the prosecution has examined the complainant / victim CW.1 as PW.1, wherein, the said witness has not supported the case of the prosecution.

The learned APP appearing for the State with permission treated the said witness as hostile and fully cross examined her, wherein, C.C.No.61212/2024 nothing has been elicited from the mouth of the PW.1 in order to prove the guilt of the accused No.1 and 2.
11.

On perusal of the materials on record and the oral & documentary evidence of P.W.1, she has categorically admitted that, she has compromised the matter with the accused Nos.1 and 2 and she is leading happy marital life with accused No.1.

In view of the evidence of P.W.1, since the matter was compromised, the prayer of the learned Senior Asst. Public Prosecutor for issuance of witness summons to other witnesses was rejected as no purpose would be served.
As the P.W.1 has turned hostile to the case of the prosecution, the evidence on record is not at all helpful to substantiate the guilt of the accused No.1 and 2.
Hence, there is no cogent and convincing evidence against the accused No.1 and 2.

Accordingly, the benefit of doubt has to be extended to the accused No.1 and 2 and hence, the Point Nos.1 to 4 are answered in the "Negative".
12. Point No.5

: - In view of the findings on above points, I proceed to pass the following;
ORDER

Acting under section 248(1) of Cr.P.C. the accused No.1 and 2 are C.C.No.61212/2024 acquitted of the offence punishable under Secs.498A, 504, 506 R/w Sec.34 of IPC and Secs.3 & 4 of State By Kr Puram Ps vs Sai Teja Man Gunta on 5 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36189317/
4 D.P.Act.
